name: Toplux Nutrition
description: US supplement brand (Lux Global Inc, Glendale, California) selling magnesium complexes, berberine, apple cider vinegar gummies and detox formulas. It has built its business almost entirely on TikTok Shop affiliate creators: its 8-form Magnesium Complex was the #2 best-selling product on TikTok Shop US in Q1 2026 with $9.5M in quarterly revenue, and third-party platform data attributes 99.7% of its sales to affiliates.

evidence.summary: FastMoss's Q1 2026 TikTok Shop US top-10 (compiled from its platform sales data) ranks Toplux Magnesium Complex 8-in-1 #2 with $9,526,928 Q1 revenue, 414,503 orders and a 30% commission — the highest commission rate in the top 10.

TokConnect's TikTok Shop data for the 30 days to October 18, 2026 shows Toplux's hero magnesium product paying 25% commission with 5,520 creators selling it, and Toplux Nutrition making $3.48M in 30 days of which 99.7% came through affiliates.

The Toplux Nutrition TikTok Shop product page shows an OFFICIAL SHOP with 4.1M units sold and 140.6K+ followers; seller information names Lux Global Inc, 1146 N Central Ave, Glendale, California, 91202.

L.E.A.D. Alliance's analysis of public TikTok data notes the @topluxnutrition account carries ~117,500 followers with zero posts of its own, and its bio exists to route creators into an affiliate relationship ('Creator? Email us for collabs') — the brand owns its category entirely through other people's content.

opportunity.title: TikTok Shop affiliate products — Toplux Nutrition official shop

reasons.niche_fit: Pure-play supplements in TikTok's strongest wellness niche (magnesium/sleep/stress), with low price points built for creator video conversion.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 99.7% of revenue is affiliate-driven per TokConnect platform data, the brand account posts nothing itself, and thousands of creators actively sell its products — the strongest possible UGC evidence.
reasons.compensation: Platform data publishes real per-product rates (30% in Q1 2026 per FastMoss, 25% in October 2026 per TokConnect) — high rates, but they vary by product and period and are not published by the brand itself, so no single rate is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: No public email or application page could be verified; the only creator route is the TikTok bio's 'email us for collabs' line and TikTok Shop itself.
reasons.opportunity_availability: TikTok Shop affiliate products are open to creators without a separate brand application.
reasons.credibility: US-registered seller (Lux Global Inc, Glendale CA) with 4.1M TikTok Shop units sold and a 4.5-rated official shop, though the brand is young and sells mainly through social commerce.

Neuro's official store sells Energy & Focus gum and mints at $24.99 with 40mg natural caffeine and L-theanine per piece, zero sugar and vegan; the brand text quoted by affiliate-toolkit claims over 10 million pieces sold.
